CREATE TABLE "public"."modulo" (
  "activo" bool DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
  "admite_anular" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  "admite_aprobar" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  "clave" character varying(80) NOT NULL,
  "grupo" character varying(60) NOT NULL,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "nombre" character varying(120) NOT NULL,
  "orden" int4 NOT NULL,
  "ruta" character varying(255),
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."rol_permiso" (
  "anular" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  "aprobar" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  "crear" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  "editar" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  "eliminar" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "modulo_id" int4 NOT NULL,
  "rol_id" int4 NOT NULL,
  "ver" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)
